name: Showcase
description: Longer, multi-part compositions that push the synthesis features: planets, monks, jazz, stories, birds and a small orchestra.
author: Tartlet

sketches.name: Planets3
sketches.description: The solar system as a choir: a pulsing sun, singing inner planets, tumbling asteroids and whistling icy bodies.
sketches.source:
setcpm(88/4)

// The Sun: deep gravitational pulse and warm, detuned solar flare drone
sun: stack(
  s("bd(3,8) ~").penv(6).pdecay(.12).shape(.3).gain(.75),
  note("<c1 [c1 g1] f1 g1>").s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.3)
    .lpf(sine.range(140, 520).slow(8)).lpq(4)
    .attack(.5).release(1.4).room(.5).gain(.35)
)

// Inner planets: singing in bright, agile soprano and alto harmonies
inner: n("{7 9 11 14 13}%8, <2 4 6 5>, 0 2 4 <6 7>, [~ 1] ~ 3(3,8)")
  .scale("C:lydian").s("sawtooth").timbre("reed")
  .vowel("a e i o u")
  .vib(5.5).vibdepth(.25)
  .lpf(tri.range(1400, 3800).slow(6))
  .every(4, x => x.add(7))
  .pan(sine.range(.2, .8).slow(3))
  .attack(.08).sustain(.7).release(.5).delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).room(.65).gain(.28)

// Asteroid belt: tumbling rocky debris between Mars and Jupiter
asteroids: s("hh*16, rim(5,16), [~ cp]*2, mt(3,8,2)")
  .degradeBy(.35).every(3, fast(2))
  .speed(rand.range(.75, 1.4)).crush(7).pan(rand).hpf(1800)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(1/12).gain(.22)

// Gas giants: Jupiter and Saturn booming in a massive baritone choir
gas_giants: n("<[0, 4, 7] [-1, 3, 6] [-2, 2, 5] [1, 5, 8]>").scale("C:lydian").transpose(-12)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.25)
  .vowel("<o a u e>")
  .vib(4.5).vibdepth(.2)
  .slow(2).lpf(sine.range(600, 1800).slow(5)).lpq(2)
  .attack(.6).sustain(.85).release(2.2).delay(.45).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.45).room(.75).size(.85).gain(.32)

// Ice giants: Uranus and Neptune as an ethereal, gliding siren duet
ice_giants: n("<6 4 9 7 11 9 13 6>").scale("C:lydian").s("triangle").timbre("hollow")
  .vowel("<u i a o>")
  .mono(1).glide(.35)
  .fm(1.2).fmh(2).vib(6).vibdepth(.35)
  .jux(rev).off(1/2, x => x.add(4))
  .room(.9).size(.95).attack(.4).sustain(.8).release(1.8).gain(.32)

// Kuiper belt: distant icy bodies singing high whistling coloratura notes
kuiper: n("7 [~ 11?] 14 [9? 16] ~ 13? [11 18?] ~").scale("C:lydian").transpose(12)
  .s("sine").timbre("glass").vowel("<i e a u>")
  .vib(6.5).vibdepth(.3)
  .slow(2).sometimesBy(.4, x => x.ply(2))
  .pan(sine.slow(5)).attack(.15).release(1.2)
  .delay(.65).delaytime(1/3).delayfeedback(.6).room(.95).size(.95).gain(.24)

sketches.name: Monks
sketches.description: Two brothers debate in plainchant over an organum drone, with cloister footsteps and vesper bells.
sketches.source:
setcpm(76/4)

// Deep organum drone in the cathedral
drone: note("<[d2, a2] [c2, g2] [d2, a2] [a1, e2]>").s("sawtooth")
  .timbre("organ").lpf(420).attack(.5).release(1.8)
  .room(.85).size(.9).gain(.35)

// Brother Thomas states the thesis (left)
thomas: n("<[0 2 3 4@2 ~ 2 0] [~ 4 5 4 3 2 ~ ~]>").scale("D:dorian")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").vowel("<o a u e o i>")
  .lpf(1400).attack(.06).release(.35)
  .vib(4.5).vibdepth(.15).pan(.25).room(.75).gain(.45)

// Brother Anselm counters in higher register (right)
anselm: n("<[~ ~ 4 6 7 6 4 3] [7 6 4@2 5 4 2@2]>").scale("D:dorian")
  .s("square").pw(.35).vowel("<a e i o u a>")
  .lpf(1600).attack(.05).release(.3)
  .every(3, rev).pan(.75).room(.75).gain(.4)

// Pacing footsteps and Wooden gavel taps in the cloister
cloister: s("bd ~ ~ <~ bd>, ~ rim?0.4 ~ [~ rim?0.6]")
  .lpf(900).room(.8).size(.85).gain(.35)

// Distant vesper bells
bells: n("<7 ~ 4 ~ 11 ~ 7 ~>").scale("D:dorian").s("sine")
  .fm(3.5).fmh(2.41).decay(2.2).release(2)
  .room(.9).pan(sine.slow(6).range(.2, .8)).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Riff
sketches.description: A small jazz combo: swing ride, walking bass, Rhodes comping on ii-V-I-IV and an improvising horn.
sketches.source:
setcpm(132/4)

// Swing ride, hi-hat on 2 & 4, and light snare chatter
drums: s("rd [~ ~ rd] rd [~ ~ rd], ~ hh ~ hh, [~ ~ sd?0.3] ~ [~ sd?0.2 ~] [~ ~ bd?0.4]")
  .gain(.75)
  .room(.3)

// Walking upright bass
bass: note("<[d2 f2 a2 g2] [g2 b2 d3 db3] [c2 e2 g2 bb2] [f2 a2 c3 eb2]>")
  .s("triangle")
  .lpf(550)
  .lpenv(1.5)
  .lpdecay(.18)
  .decay(.35)
  .sustain(.1)
  .gain(.85)

// Syncopated Rhodes comping on ii-V-I-IV
chords: note("<[f3,a3,c4,e4] [f3,a3,b3,e4] [e3,g3,b3,d4] [eb3,g3,a3,d4]>")
  .struct("[~ ~ x] [~ ~ x?] ~ [x? ~ ~]")
  .s("sine")
  .fm(1.2)
  .fmh(2)
  .trem(5)
  .tremdepth(.2)
  .decay(.6)
  .sustain(.2)
  .release(.4)
  .pan(.35)
  .room(.4)
  .gain(.45)

// Improvising horn solo
lead: n("[0 ~ 2] [4 6 5] [~ 3 1] [<7 9> ~ <4 2>]")
  .scale("C:major")
  .add(7)
  .sometimesBy(.35, rev)
  .sometimesBy(.25, x => x.add(2))
  .degradeBy(.15)
  .s("sawtooth")
  .timbre("reed")
  .mono(1)
  .glide(.04)
  .lpf(sine.range(1100, 2600).slow(5))
  .vib(5)
  .vibdepth(.25)
  .attack(.03)
  .decay(.25)
  .sustain(.5)
  .release(.15)
  .pan(.65)
  .room(.45)
  .gain(.55)

sketches.name: Story
sketches.description: An eight-cycle narrative arc: dawn, journey, storm and resolution.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/4)

// An 8-cycle narrative arc: Dawn (1-2), Journey (3-4), Storm (5-6), Resolution (7-8)

// The Hero's Theme: evolves from tentative steps to a rapid climb, then resolves
hero: n("<[~ 0 ~ 2] [4 ~ 3 2] [0 2 4 7] [6 4 2 4] [7 9 11 7]*2 [11 9 7 4]*2 [7 ~ 4 2] [0 ~ ~ ~]>")
  .scale("E:minor").s("triangle").timbre("glass")
  .delay(.35).delaytime(3/8).room(.5).release(.4).gain(.6)

// The World: shifting harmonic landscape with a rising and falling filter
world: note("<[e3,g3,b3] [d3,f#3,a3] [c3,e3,g3] [d3,f#3,a3] [c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [b2,eb3,f#3,a3] [c3,e3,g3,b3] [e2,b2,e3,g#3]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.25)
  .lpf(sine.range(500, 2400).slow(8)).lpq(2)
  .attack(.4).release(1.5).room(.6).gain(.35)

// The Undercurrent: bass that awakens on the journey and drives the storm
shadow: note("<e1 ~ c1*4 d1*4 a0*8 b0*8 c1*2 e1>")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf("<300 300 600 700 1200 1500 500 350>")
  .lpenv(2).lpdecay(.15).release(.2).gain(.55)

// Footsteps & Tempest: percussion enters in chapter 2 and peaks in chapter 3
pulse: s("<~ [~ ~ ~ rim] [bd ~ sd ~, hh*4] [bd [~ bd] sd ~, hh*8] [bd*2 sd bd sd, hh*8, ~ oh] [bd*4, [~ cp]*2, cr ~ ~ [sd sd]] [bd ~ rim ~, hh*4] [cr ~ ~ ~]>")
  .room(.3).gain(.7)

// Wind: swells during the storm
wind: s("pink").hpf(400).lpf(sine.range(300, 3000).slow(8))
  .gain("<.05 .08 .1 .15 .35 .45 .15 .04>").pan(sine.slow(3))

sketches.name: Planets2
sketches.description: The solar system with synths: brassy gas giants, FM ice giants and glittering Kuiper belt bells.
sketches.source:
setcpm(88/4)

// The Sun: deep gravitational pulse and warm, detuned solar flare drone
sun: stack(
  s("bd(3,8) ~").penv(6).pdecay(.12).shape(.3).gain(.75),
  note("<c1 [c1 g1] f1 g1>").s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.3)
    .lpf(sine.range(140, 520).slow(8)).lpq(4)
    .attack(.5).release(1.4).room(.5).gain(.38)
)

// Inner planets: Mercury (fast), Venus (warm), Earth (steady), Mars (red/syncopated)
inner: n("{7 9 11 14 13}%8, <2 4 6 5>, 0 2 4 <6 7>, [~ 1] ~ 3(3,8)")
  .scale("C:lydian").s("triangle").timbre("bright")
  .lpf(tri.range(900, 3200).slow(6)).lpenv(2).lpdecay(.18)
  .every(4, x => x.add(7))
  .pan(sine.range(.2, .8).slow(3))
  .release(.25).delay(.25).delaytime(3/16).room(.45).gain(.3)

// Asteroid belt: tumbling rocky debris between Mars and Jupiter
asteroids: s("hh*16, rim(5,16), [~ cp]*2, mt(3,8,2)")
  .degradeBy(.35).every(3, fast(2))
  .speed(rand.range(.75, 1.4)).crush(7).pan(rand).hpf(1800)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(1/12).gain(.24)

// Gas giants: Jupiter (massive brassy) and Saturn (ringed echoes)
gas_giants: n("<[0, 4, 7] [-1, 3, 6] [-2, 2, 5] [1, 5, 8]>").scale("C:lydian").transpose(-12)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.25)
  .slow(2).lpf(sine.range(350, 950).slow(5)).lpq(3).lpenv(1.5).lpattack(.6)
  .attack(.6).release(1.8).delay(.45).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.45).room(.6).gain(.3)

// Ice giants: Uranus (axial-tilted jux/rev) and Neptune (deep windy FM)
ice_giants: n("<6 4 9 7>").scale("C:lydian").s("sine").timbre("hollow")
  .fm(1.5).fmh(2).vib(4).vibdepth(.25)
  .slow(2).jux(rev).off(1/4, x => x.add(4))
  .room(.85).size(.9).attack(.6).release(2).gain(.28)

// Kuiper belt: Pluto and distant icy bodies glittering in the outer dark
kuiper: n("7 [~ 11?] 14 [9? 16] ~ 13? [11 18?] ~").scale("C:lydian").transpose(12)
  .s("sine").timbre("glass").fm(2.5).fmh(3)
  .slow(2).sometimesBy(.4, x => x.ply(2))
  .pan(sine.slow(5)).delay(.65).delaytime(1/3).delayfeedback(.6).room(.9).size(.95).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Haunted
sketches.description: A detuned music box, swelling organ, a heartbeat in the attic and cold wind in the halls.
sketches.source:
setcpm(72/4)

// Detuned, ghostly music box melody
musicbox: note("c5 eb5 b4 f#5 g4 eb5 d5 ab4").s("sine").timbre("glass")
  .fm(2).fmh(3.01)
  .vib(4).vibdepth(0.25)
  .delay(0.5).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(0.6)
  .room(0.8).size(0.9)
  .every(4, rev).gain(0.45)

// Ominous swelling organ chords
organ: note("<[c2,eb3,g3,b3] [b1,d3,f3,ab3] [eb2,gb3,bb3,d4] [f#1,a2,c3,eb3]>").s("sawtooth").timbre("organ")
  .unison(3).detune(0.35)
  .lpf(sine.range(300, 1100).slow(4))
  .attack(0.6).release(1.5).room(0.7).gain(0.35)

// Heartbeat pulse and creaking footsteps in the attic
footsteps: s("[bd bd] ~ ~ ~, ~ [rim?0.6 ~] ~ [rim | cp?0.3]")
  .lpf(900).room(0.8).size(0.9)
  .delay(0.3).delaytime(1/6).gain(0.65)

// Cold wind howling through the hallways
wind: s("pink").lpf(sine.range(150, 700).slow(6)).lpq(4)
  .attack(1).release(1).room(0.9).pan(sine.slow(5)).gain(0.22)

sketches.name: Birds
sketches.description: Songbirds, warblers, finches, a woodpecker and mourning doves in a breezy forest.
sketches.source:
setcpm(110/4)

// Songbird lead: swooping syrinx whistles with pitch-envelope chirps and trills
$: n("[7 9 11]? ~ [12 9 7]*2 ~ [11 14 11]?").scale("F:lydian").transpose(24)
  .s("sine").mono(1).glide(.03)
  .penv("<12 -9 15 -12 7>").pdecay(.05)
  .vib(24).vibdepth("<0 1.5 3 0.5>")
  .attack(.005).decay(.09).sustain(0).release(.03)
  .sometimesBy(.5, x => x.ply(3).penv(7).pdecay(.025))
  .pan(rand.range(.1, .9))
  .delay(.35).delaytime(3/16).delayfeedback(.35)
  .room(.6).size(.8).gain(.55)

// Answering canopy warbler: rapid FM-throated twittering
$: n("~ [14|16 12 9 14]*2? ~ [16 18 14]*3?").scale("F:lydian").transpose(24)
  .s("sine").fm(1.5).fmh(2)
  .penv(-12).pdecay(.035)
  .vib(30).vibdepth(2)
  .attack(.003).decay(.05).sustain(0).release(.02)
  .sometimes(x => x.fast(2).ply(2))
  .pan(rand.range(.1, .9))
  .room(.7).size(.85).gain(.4)

// Tiny finch peeps: sharp upward pitch-swept sine chirps
$: freq("[2200|2600 3100]?0.5 ~ [3400 2500|2900]*2?0.6 ~")
  .s("sine")
  .penv(14).pdecay(.025)
  .attack(.002).decay(.04).sustain(0).release(.01)
  .sometimes(x => x.ply(4).fast(1.5))
  .pan(rand.range(0, 1))
  .room(.5).gain(.35)

// Woodpecker drumming on hollow bark and fluttering wings
$: s("rim*8?0.4 ~ [~ hh*6?0.4] ~")
  .speed(rand.range(1.6, 2.4))
  .lpf(3200).hpf(500)
  .pan(sine.slow(3).range(.2, .8))
  .room(.6).gain(.35)

// Mourning dove coos: breathy low-register sliding calls
$: n("~ [0 4 2@2]? ~ [0 2 0@2]?").scale("F:lydian")
  .s("sine").timbre("soft").mono(1).glide(.08)
  .penv(3).pdecay(.12)
  .vib(7).vibdepth(.4)
  .attack(.06).decay(.35).sustain(0).release(.15)
  .room(.7).size(.8).gain(.45)

// Gentle forest breeze through the leaves
$: s("pink")
  .lpf(sine.slow(5).range(400, 1100)).hpf(250)
  .attack(1).release(2)
  .pan(sine.slow(7).range(.2, .8))
  .room(.6).gain(.12)

sketches.name: Synthphony
sketches.description: A synthesized orchestra: strings, harp, reed solo, celesta, cello and cinematic percussion.
sketches.source:
setcpm(84/4)

// Lush orchestral strings with unison detune, filter swells, and 9th/11th voicings
strings: n("<[0,2,4,6,8] [1,3,5,8,10] [-2,0,2,4,6] [-1,1,4,6,9]>")
  .scale("Eb:lydian").s("sawtooth")
  .unison(4).detune(.25)
  .attack(.8).decay(1).sustain(.7).release(2.5)
  .lpf(sine.range(500, 2200).slow(8)).lpenv(1.5).lpattack(1.2)
  .room(.85).size(.95).gain(.24)

// Intricate polymetric harp and woodwind arpeggios dancing in stereo
harp: n("{0 2 4 6 7 9 11 13 9 6}%8")
  .scale("Eb:lydian").s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .every(3, rev).jux(x => x.iter(4).add(7).late(1/16))
  .sometimesBy(.25, x => x.ply(2))
  .decay(.35).sustain(0).release(.5)
  .delay(.4).delaytime(3/16).delayfeedback(.5)
  .room(.7).gain(.3)

// Expressive reed solo with legato glide, vibrato, and ornamental grace notes
solo: n("<[7 ~ 6 [4 5]] [2 ~ 3 0] [4 6 [7 9] 11] [8 ~ 6 <4 9>]>")
  .scale("Eb:lydian").s("sine").timbre("reed").transpose(12)
  .mono(1).glide(.08).vib(5).vibdepth(.2)
  .attack(.12).decay(.4).sustain(.8).release(.9)
  .vowel("<a o e i>").room(.75).gain(.42)

// Shimmering FM celesta bells in the upper register
celesta: n("<[~ 11 ~ 14] [~ 13 11 9] [~ 7 ~ 11] [13 ~ 9 6]>")
  .scale("Eb:lydian").s("sine").timbre("glass").transpose(12)
  .fm(2.5).fmh(3).decay(.6).sustain(0).release(1.4)
  .pan(sine.range(.2, .8).slow(3))
  .delay(.5).delaytime(3/8).room(.85).gain(.2)

// Deep contrabass and cello foundation with bow envelope and octave movement
cello: n("<[0 ~ ~ -7] [1 ~ 5 1] [-2 ~ ~ -5] [-1 ~ 3 -1]>")
  .scale("Eb:lydian").s("sawtooth").transpose(-12)
  .unison(2).detune(.12)
  .attack(.25).decay(.6).sustain(.6).release(1.2)
  .lpf(320).lpenv(2).lpattack(.2).lpdecay(.8)
  .room(.5).gain(.48)

// Cinematic percussion with rolling timpani, rim clicks, and cymbal swells
timpani: s("bd ~ [~ lt] <mt [lt ht]>, ~ ~ <~ cr> ~, rd(5,8,1), ~ rim?0.4 ~ [rim?0.3 ~]")
  .every(4, x => x.fast(2).degradeBy(.3))
  .speed("<.75 .7 .8 .72>").lpf(1800)
  .room(.8).size(.9).gain(.4)
